coverage.summary: Applies to residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley. The chapter states no limits on unit count, building age or construction date, owner type, or landlord size.

evidence.quoted_span: levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.

result.notes: Four changes. (1) Removed the reference to the state Cartwright Act (Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729) from the summary because no document supports it. (2) Removed the vendor and landlord conduct description from the summary, since coverage describes units, not conduct. (3) Set other_conditions to null. The listed exclusions (aggregated anonymous reports, affordable-housing limit products, market research, appraisal and software-training uses) narrow the definition of a 'coordinated pricing algorithm', which concerns the regulated product and conduct, not which buildings or units are covered; they belong in the rule's exemptions field. (4) Set requires_unknown_facts to false because the ban reaches all ordinary residential dwelling units in Berkeley. The unit, age and landlord-size fields stay null because the ordinance states no such limits.
